model.as: xg-dino (ablation.model_for, C_GRID, inner CV over the other host folds, no extra Platt layer)

verdicts.explains most: gain Holm-rejected and its one-sided 95% upper bound < 0 and the 5th percentile of R - 0.5 G > 0

holm.flags_le0: the family's Holm with flags_le0 in place of flags

contract.boundary_gate: 'does not explain' only if the false 'does not explain' rate at the planted R = 0.25 G (Xc controls) <= 0.05; else it reads 'inconclusive' (raw verdict beside); evaluated from the validation record below
contract.ratio: R / G unclipped, the draws' 2.5 / 97.5 percentiles, reportable only when G's 95% interval excludes 0; draws with G <= 0 counted
contract.c_minus_bx: C1 wording: 'DINOv2 adds' if the one-sided 95% upper bound < 0; else equivalent at δ = 0.002 (90% interval inside ±δ); else inconclusive, smallest margin shown
contract.wording: predictive redundancy with DINOv2, never causal identification

estimands: unseen standardised to the primary goal rate
leak.verdict: 'not decidable' if a heterogeneity 95% interval excludes 0 or the no_v3 95% interval excludes the primary point; else 'decidable' (ablation.leak_verdict)
leak.limits: these controls cannot resolve small attenuations

distance.rule: bottom x <= q1/3, top x > q2/3, contrast top - bottom

crowding.rule: bottom x <= q1/3, top x > q2/3, contrast top - bottom

framing.rule: bottom x <= q1/3, top x > q2/3, contrast top - bottom

subgroups.header_gpt: head vs foot on the GPT sample, stratum-weighted
subgroups.d: per-shot ℓ_C - ℓ_B of the run's B and C, which replay results/xgdino_ablation/real on the real labels (max |Δp| reported)

fills.disagreement: the two fills differ in the Holm decision -> inconclusive

estimands.refit: C refitted (same folds, inner CV, penalties) with z_g_combo replaced by the masked z, geometry fixed: information left (primary)
estimands.frozen: the fitted C fold models applied to the masked z: reliance of the deployed model

masking.test: per region: d1 = ΔLL(masked - unmasked), d2 = ΔLL(masked - placebo); one-sided p_i = (1 + #{draws <= 0}) / (B + 1) (degradation > 0); p = max(p1, p2); Holm over the family at 0.05; positive = 'sensitivity to the intervention', not proof of what DINOv2 uses
masking.placebo: the region's patch mask translated (ticket 09: y-band ±1 patch row, on the pitch, off persons, ball and goal), 3 seeded draws; the per-shot log-loss is averaged over the draws
masking.shooter+ball: the union of the stored shooter and ball masks, present when both are; its placebos: regions.placebos(union, allowed, regions.rng_for(shot_id, 'shooter+ball')) with ticket 09's allowed patches (replayed in ticket 14)
masking.population: shots with the region present (primary; others keep the unmasked frame); all shots descriptive; goal tested on its placebo-feasible subset only (labelled); a shot without a valid placebo is out of the test population of its region
masking.gain_left: (LL_B - LL_C_mask) / (LL_B - LL_C), point and the draws' 95% interval
masking.size_bins: read-outs binned by region size in patches (terciles of the present shots, frozen at the read-out)
masking.overlap: the pairwise region overlap matrix (`region_overlap`): ball vs shooter and goal vs goalkeeper are not separable by remove-masks alone

probes.primary_label: header_gpt (GPT-6.1 Sol low on the 1,000-shot sample; unclear missing); metrics weighted by the stratum weights (primary), unweighted beside; reported by outcome
probes.secondary_label: header_caption: header 1, foot 0, unknown missing; reported by outcome
probes.z_diff: logit p_C - logit p_B of the frozen xg-dino OOF (results/xgdino_ablation/real), alone and beyond geometry (the geometry design of B vs geometry + embedding, incremental held-out R²)
probes.kind: binary when every finite value is 0 or 1 (AUC), else continuous / count (R², MAE)
probes.encoders: frozen DINOv2 and G-combo blocks 20-23 (five-fold-model routing, C1), offsets 0 and -400 ms
probes.rules: C2 thresholds unchanged (xg-dino protocol fd142d15...: encodes beyond distance ΔR² >= 0.05 / ΔAUC >= 0.03 with 95% lower bound > 0; readable R² >= 0.30 / AUC >= 0.70); nested layer selection; BH at q = 0.05 within each family (target x encoder x offset); the header probe's 'encoded beyond distance' is a readability statement only
probes.labels_barred: header_gpt and header_caption are probe targets and subgroup keys only (labels.assert_not_design)

disclosures: Development comparisons on the 328 training matches, out of fold; not an independent test (172 matches spent).

C6 optimism (C1): G-combo's epoch and temperature were chosen on each scored fold, so C and C+X carry optimism that B and B+X do not. G = LL_B - LL_C and C - (B+X) are tilted toward 'DINOv2 adds'; R_X = G - G_X compares two differences that both carry it, so the tilt partly cancels but is not removed.
Verdicts state predictive redundancy with DINOv2, never causal identification of what DINOv2 uses.

The quality-like block Xq and xg-dino's Q may carry broadcast / annotation artefacts (C1 named Q an outcome-correlated channel); their read-outs are descriptive. BQ - B = -0.0065 (67% of C - B) is the known baseline.

SoccerNet flags are retrospective context; sn_direct_fk reaches +300 ms; the <= 0 ms window is the sensitivity (C3.3). t0 is not certified pre-contact: if only ball_t0 / motion close the gap the wording is 'ball flight / post-contact', not 'body part'.
Motion is present on 39% of shots (identity rule: mutual nearest within 4 m); missing values are mean-filled with an indicator, so the motion block also carries 'motion measurable'.
The leak controls (no_v3 1,028 shots, unseen 3,249 shots with 5% goals) cannot resolve small attenuations.
Header labels (caption, GPT) are noisy measurements; caption precision against GPT differs by outcome (goal 0.82, no goal 0.62), so caption-based reads are outcome-dependent; GPT is primary.

The control truths are label-free (z's projection on the geometry and Xc designs), with the planted G set to xg-dino's observed C - B (0.0097); the null puts the whole image signal outside span(B, Xc), so every content block is null at once.
Refitted-subset leak estimates are not computed (C1: descriptive only); the restricted estimands carry the verdict.

The controls show the recovered R_X biased low out of fold (B+X recovers less of the image signal than its oracle, most for the wide Xc block); 'does not explain' is therefore gated by its boundary control (boundary_gate) and 'explains part / most' are conservative.

boundary_gate.rule: 'does not explain' only if the false 'does not explain' rate at the plant R = 0.25 G (Xc) <= 0.05; else every 'does not explain' reads 'inconclusive' (the raw verdict reported beside)

name_collisions.rule: Xa design columns are namespaced xa_<name>

dry_run.masking: label-free stand-in masked z = z + N(0, 0.5²) on the region's shots
